description: Source code for Xen event channel management in Zephyr OS, including functions for allocating, binding, unbinding, and handling event channels and their interrupts.

methods.name: empty_callback
methods.description: Default callback invoked when no specific handler is registered for an event channel.

methods.name: alloc_unbound_event_channel
methods.description: Allocates an unbound event channel for the current domain to a remote domain.

methods.name: alloc_unbound_event_channel_dom0
methods.description: Allocates an unbound event channel for a specified domain (used in dom0).

methods.name: bind_interdomain_event_channel
methods.description: Binds an interdomain event channel to a remote domain and port, with a callback.

methods.name: evtchn_status
methods.description: Retrieves the status of an event channel.

methods.name: evtchn_set_priority
methods.description: Sets the priority of an event channel.

methods.name: notify_evtchn
methods.description: Sends a notification on an event channel.

methods.name: bind_event_channel
methods.description: Binds a callback to an event channel port.

methods.name: unbind_event_channel
methods.description: Unbinds the callback from an event channel port.

methods.name: get_missed_events
methods.description: Checks if there are missed events on a port.
